notes: The supplied text is not the Fashion Design A.A. program section: it is an alphabetical index of course codes and titles (ESL through FLO), cut off mid-entry at 'FLO 290 - Floral Creati'. No requirements, units, totals, outcomes or careers are printed, so no blocks were recorded and section_heading is left empty.
The source URL points to the Photography A.A. page (digital-media-arts/photography-aa), not a Fashion Design page; the correct catalog page should be retrieved and re-read.

All closed-list FASH courses appear in the index, along with other FASH courses not on the closed list (e.g., FASH 210, 213, 23, 230, 240, 244, 258, 271WE, 39, 41, 46, 47, 52 and 600-level noncredit twins), but the text does not show which, if any, belong to the A.A. degree.
